items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, you had Cesar Chavez. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, he took California because of the workers.

ctx.x: We went to see the circus. We sat up in the corner. Actually it was in Grand Circus Park in Detroit, Michigan. It was right downtown, Lynwood Avenue. Every year, J.L Hudson used to have a parade. It was on T.V. around the country with the big floats, and the balloons and the singing kids. We were allowed to go there and stand in line with people and watch it. When we went to the Michigan Theatre we had to sit in the back row, you know? We weren’t even allowed in Dearborn even though that’s where the Ford Factory…
